gloss: dish topped with thick starchy sauce

definitions.gloss: dish topped with thick starchy sauce; ankake
definitions.explanation: A preparation in which a dashi- or broth-based sauce thickened with potato starch is poured over food such as tofu, fish, noodles, or rice. Also refers to the sauce itself.

examples.japanese: {餡|あん}かけ{豆腐|どうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered tofu with thick sauce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餡|あん}かけ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat Chinese-style ankake yakisoba.

examples.japanese: ⟦{揚|あ}げた→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧きのこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餡|あん}かけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I served the deep-fried fish topped generously with a mushroom ankake sauce.

notes:
The ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧ here is not sweet bean paste but a savory thickened sauce, made by stirring water-dissolved ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧ (potato starch) into hot broth.

COMPOUNDS:
- {餡|あん}かけ{豆腐|どうふ}: tofu in thick sauce
- {餡|あん}かけ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: fried noodles topped with ankake
- {餡|あん}かけ⟦チャーハン→チャーハン：17671_chaahan⟧: fried rice topped with ankake
- きのこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餡|あん}かけ: mushroom ankake sauce

The ankake style keeps food hot longer because the thick sauce traps heat, making it a common winter preparation.
